recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game named **Chosen Hall: Spellbound Term**. Preserve a top-down survival arena where the player drags anywhere to move, an orbiting automatic charm attacks enemies, edge-spawned hazards chase or shoot, pickups upgrade attack/defense/speed/health, score increases from defeated hazards, class level rises by kill count, and a boss appears after 30 defeats. Reframe the game as a cozy gothic wizard-school adventure starring a chosen first-year student exploring a candlelit castle hall. Use procedural Canvas/CSS for vaulted corridors, moving staircases, arched windows, star motes, house crest UI, magical spell particles, enchanted books, ink imps, armor, portraits, and a restricted-wing wraith. Keep CTAs large, readable, and tappable for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait viewports.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a mobile-first top-down survival arena. The player drags/touches to move a central hero while an orbiting weapon automatically damages enemies. Enemies spawn from edges, chase or shoot, damage the hero on contact/projectile collision, drop upgrades, award score, and after 30 kills trigger a large boss. The loop ends in defeat when HP reaches zero or victory when the boss is defeated.

## Protected mechanics
- Drag/touch/click movement toward pointer on the canvas.
- Continuous requestAnimationFrame update/draw loop.
- Enemy spawn timing and edge-based entry.
- Enemy movement families: chaser, erratic, tank, shooter.
- Contact/projectile damage, player HP, loot upgrades, score/kills/level increments.
- Boss threshold, boss HP, boss collision/attack, victory and defeat overlays.

## Remix blueprint
Rebuild the same loop as a wizard-school castle trial. The player is a chosen student, enemies are enchanted school hazards, loot is class mastery, score is House Points, HP is Courage, and the boss is a Restricted Wing Wraith. Presentation is rebuilt with procedural castle corridors, gothic UI, house crest, spell particles, readable portrait controls, and catalog-approved fantasy fonts/audio.
